name: surveyor_n_walk_v01
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: hand-painted NONPIXEL miniature NPC four-frame animation. Input image is the EXACT canonical single neutral model, not a suggestion. Keep the same compact 2.7-head proportions and SAME skull size, face angle, crown, shoulders, torso, pelvis and costume. Chestnut-brown chin-length bob hair, green eyes, small white daisy-and-leaf ornament on her anatomical LEFT temple, human round ears. Olive-green short hooded travel cape with hood DOWN behind bare head, pale gold botanical trim, ivory puff-sleeve blouse and layered short ivory skirt, brown fitted lace-up waist corset and leather belt, opaque dark-brown tights, brown mid-calf lace-up boots with small leaves. ONE brown field satchel on anatomical RIGHT hip and a closed brown embossed leaf field notebook held low by LEFT hand, right hand relaxed. Preserve her botanical researcher silhouette and muted olive/ivory/brown palette from portrait. Do not turn cape into a raised hood or give her an archer bow. Camera locked to straight BACK, looking away upward; never turn head/body. Draw one slow in-place WALK CYCLE, four DISTINCT chronological poses in 2x2 reading order. Frame1 anatomical RIGHT leg (screen RIGHT) strides away/up, LEFT leg trails down. Frame2 RIGHT planted under pelvis while LEFT knee swings away. Frame3 LEFT leg (screen LEFT) strides away/up and RIGHT trails down with sole visible. Frame4 LEFT planted and RIGHT knee swings away. Alternate screen-left and screen-right trailing boot. Keep upper body upright, pelvis height and leg/boot lengths constant. Hands/props retain original low carrying position, no extra hand. Small cloth/ponytail sway only. Lower legs must visibly exchange front/back ownership; DO NOT repeat same leading leg in frame3. Composition: four separate COMPLETE full-body figures in equal2x2 cells. Each figure occupies ONLY 70% of cell height with 15% EMPTY TRANSPARENT border ABOVE hair, BELOW soles, and around all props. Generous margin especially ponytail/ahoge. Each has exactly2 arms/2 hands/2 legs. No cut-off body edges or touching cells. Refined broad soft-painted shading exactly matching reference. True transparent RGBA background; no shadow/floor, letters/numbers/gridlines, particles, props not in model, camera change, growth/shrink, alternate costume, labels or backdrop. Preserve anatomical accessory sides.
